name: Authored anatomical flesh body v4
method: New smooth-union SDF anatomical forms and vertex paint around the original Meshy skeleton. Original paw vertices define clean convex hull faces; the original rig and contact attributes remain byte exact. This is a locally authored derivative, not a new Meshy generation.

reproducibility.method: Ran tracked inventory, authoring and packing scripts twice into independent fresh output folders with explicit inputs. Both packed GLBs and the integrated asset are byte identical.
reproducibility.scope: Verified on the listed Windows/Python/Node/library environment; cross-platform bit identity is not asserted.

limitations: Real browser animation and independent art review are separate required checks.
New topology has authored normalized skin weights; original atlas UVs apply only to retained source vertices. New body appearance uses vertex colors.
The new mesh stores the original contact pool even where those original triangles are no longer drawn.
Some blended new surfaces reduce mixed influences to the largest four; the recorded discarded influence mass concerns new authored weights only. Original weights are unchanged.
SourceContactVertices metadata must remain available to contact inspection. The legacy smoothing for the old shredded mesh must be skipped for authoredFlesh assets.
changesSincePrevious: Restore a smooth upper cranial crest around [-0.064,1.42,0.66], radii [0.20,0.20,0.20], primarily attached to Bone_053 and Bone_029. It restores visible anatomy crossed by the existing combat-height rays. No combat math, range, target proxy or tolerances changed.
